<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/payment_requests"}
#docs
`mode=charge` charges the live total at once (credit on file is applied first); a decline leaves the request open and emails the link. `mode=link` emails a link the customer pays once.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invoices` | `array of string` | **yes** | The invoices (inv_…). Each must be open, owe money and be in no other open request. |
| `mode` | `string` | **yes** | charge: charge now. link: send the customer a link. One of `charge`, `link`. |
| `payment_method` | `string` | no | The payment method to charge (pm_…). Default: the customer's primary method. |
| `email` | `string` | no | Send the link here instead of the customer's billing email. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid invoices, or charge refused (manual-payment invoice, no payment method) |
| `404` | No such customer or invoice |
| `409` | An invoice is already in an open request, or a payment on it is in progress |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "invoices": [
      "inv_XXXXXXXXXXXX01"
    ],
    "mode": "charge",
    "email": "maya@example.com"
  }'
```
